name: theme
title: Lime theme
description: Support file: tokens, scoped base and the Tailwind v4 theme mapping.
author: design.how
docs:
Lime is scoped: its styles apply only inside an element with the class lime.
1. Import the theme once, in the root layout, as its own stylesheet (not an @import in globals.css): import '@/components/lime/styles.css'
2. Put className="lime" on the element that holds Lime UI, usually <body>. Lime's classes work on the elements inside it, in your own code too, not on that element itself.
3. Wrap the app inside that element in <LimePortalProvider> from '@/lib/lime/portal', so dialogs and menus keep the theme.
Dark mode: put data-theme="dark" on the lime element or any ancestor, such as <html>. The theme does not follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme) on its own.
Components: npx shadcn@latest add https://design.how/r/lime/<name>.json; https://design.how/r/lime/registry.json lists them all.
